summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 18, 2026, containing a press release that discloses a routine transaction by a person discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR). The filing reports that Kingsley Wheaton, Chief Corporate Officer, sold a total of 781 ordinary shares of 25p each on the London Stock Exchange at prices between 49.52 and 49.57 (GBp). The aggregate sale value was approximately £38,693.67. No special-situation event is present; this is an ordinary insider dealing notification, not a corporate action requiring classification.
